/* T-4287 (friesevan #41 c6859513854): In flight and Queued show every row, in a box of fixed height that scrolls on
   its own. overscroll-behavior stays auto, so at the box's top or bottom a swipe or a trackpad scroll passes on to
   the page (no trap), and the box is never taller than 60% of the screen, so the page always has room to be scrolled
   outside it. The soft edges (backgrounds that ride with the content, over shadows fixed to the box) say rows sit
   above or below. tabindex 0 lets the keyboard scroll it; every row's own controls are in the page as before. T-4316:
   a wheel or trackpad takes a box only once the pointer has moved inside it (look.js). */
.lk-box{max-height:min(60vh,560px);overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior-y:auto;box-sizing:border-box;padding:var(--s2) var(--s2) 0;margin-bottom:var(--s2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);scrollbar-gutter:stable;background:linear-gradient(var(--bg) 40%,transparent) top/100% 28px no-repeat local,linear-gradient(transparent,var(--bg) 60%) bottom/100% 28px no-repeat local,radial-gradient(farthest-side at 50% 0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 20%,transparent),transparent) top/100% 12px no-repeat scroll,radial-gradient(farthest-side at 50% 100%,color-mix(in srgb,var(--ink) 20%,transparent),transparent) bottom/100% 12px no-repeat scroll;background-color:var(--bg)}
.lk-box:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.lk-box>p{margin:0 0 var(--s2)}.lk-box:has(>.lk-qs:empty){display:none}
.lk-qs.lk-qshort>.lk-fold{display:none}
/* T-3735: Blocked or waiting, its own block under All tasks: each row's reason in its own words, what it names linked */
.lk-bk{min-height:48px;padding:6px var(--s3)}.lk-bk img{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;filter:var(--portrait-filter)}
.lk-home .lk-bk .t b{font-size:var(--fs-0);font-weight:600}.lk-home .lk-bk .t .lk-bw{display:block;margin-top:2px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-bw a{color:var(--blue-fg);font-weight:600}.lk-bw .lk-iss,.lk-bw .lk-bt{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-bk .idb{display:none}.lk-bw a{display:inline-block;min-height:24px;line-height:24px}}
.lk-lm{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--s2);padding-top:var(--s2)}.lk-lm label{display:flex;gap:var(--s2);align-items:center;min-height:44px;font-size:var(--fs-1)}.lk-lm input{width:22px;height:22px}.lk-lm .lk-lb{display:flex;gap:var(--s2);flex-wrap:wrap}.lk-lm button{min-height:44px;flex:1 1 120px}.lk-lm button.on{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.lk-lm>p{margin:0}
.lk-more{display:block;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;text-align:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s2);font:600 var(--fs-0) var(--font);color:var(--accent);background:var(--bg);cursor:pointer;margin-bottom:var(--s2)}
summary.lk-more{list-style:none}summary.lk-more::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}details[open]>summary.lk-more{display:none}
.lk-q{min-height:48px;padding:6px var(--s3)}.lk-q img{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;filter:var(--portrait-filter)}.lk-q .lk-n{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);min-width:14px}
.lk-q .t b{font-size:var(--fs-0);font-weight:600}
.idb{font:11px var(--mono);background:var(--grey-bg);color:var(--grey-fg);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;line-height:14px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}
/* T-3232: on a phone an Investor request open 48 h or more has this badge on its Queued row, in place of the side panel */
.lk-yb{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:var(--hot-bg);color:var(--hot);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.lk-wait{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber-fg);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:1px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
.lk-idle{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber-fg);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 8px;font-weight:600}
.lk-ssd{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:2px 8px;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.lk-ssd.no{background:var(--hot-bg);color:var(--hot)}.lk-ssdl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:var(--s2);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-rec{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:2px 8px}
.lk-pan{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s4);margin-top:var(--s5)}
.lk-pan h2{font-size:var(--fs-4);font-weight:800;margin:0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--s3);flex-wrap:wrap}
.lk-pan h3{font-size:var(--fs-2);font-weight:800;margin:var(--s4) 0 var(--s2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:var(--s3);flex-wrap:wrap}
.lk-pan h2 small,.lk-pan h3 small{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-kind{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;line-height:16px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 7px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid var(--line);margin-right:2px}
.lk-kind.mc{background:var(--pink-bg);color:var(--pink-fg);border-color:var(--pink-bg)}
.lk-sims{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:var(--s3);margin-top:var(--s3)}
.lk-sim{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s3)}.lk-sim>b{font-weight:700;font-size:var(--fs-0);display:block}.lk-sim>span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-blk{display:flex;gap:var(--s2);align-items:center;margin-top:var(--s2);border-radius:var(--r-s);padding:var(--s2);background:var(--accent-soft);border:1px solid var(--accent);color:var(--blue-fg);font-size:12px}
.lk-blk b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:var(--fs-0)}.lk-blk>span{min-width:0}
.lk-blk.free{background:none;border:1px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted)}
.lk-blk img,.lk-qr img{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;filter:var(--portrait-filter)}
.lk-nf{display:inline-block;box-sizing:border-box;border-radius:50%;flex:none;border:1px dashed var(--line)}
.lk-qr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s3);background:var(--grey-bg);border:1px dashed var(--grey-fg);color:var(--grey-fg);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s2) var(--s3);margin-bottom:var(--s2);font-size:12px}
.lk-qr b{flex:1;color:var(--ink);font-size:var(--fs-0);min-width:0}
.lk-qr b small{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--grey-fg)}
.lk-bnr{grid-template-columns:190px 1fr 1fr}.lk-bnr>b small{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--grey-fg)}
.lk-bnr .lk-bar2{grid-template-columns:1fr 64px}.lk-p .hd+.lk-bnr{margin-top:0}
.lk-nm{display:block;border:1px dashed var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 var(--s2);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}
.lk-card.lk-run{padding:var(--s2) var(--s3)}.lk-home .lk-run .t b{font-size:14px;line-height:1.3}.lk-run .t span{font-size:12px}
.lk-run .lk-faces img{width:32px;height:32px}.lk-run .lk-faces img+img{margin-left:-12px}
.lk-q{min-height:44px;padding:4px var(--s3)}.lk-home .lk-q .t b{font-size:13px;line-height:1.3}
.lk-home .lk-tn,.lk-home .t b.lk-tn{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;overflow-wrap:break-word}
.lk-home .lk-open .lk-tn,.lk-home .lk-open .t b.lk-tn{display:block;-webkit-line-clamp:none;line-clamp:none;overflow:visible}
.lk-home .lk-tn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.lk-open{border-color:var(--accent)}
.lk-star{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;flex:none;align-self:flex-start;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:32px;height:32px;margin:-6px -8px -6px 0;border-radius:50%;font-size:18px;line-height:1;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}
.lk-star.on,.lk-star[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--amber-fg)}span.lk-star{cursor:default}.lk-star:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent)}
.lk-q .lk-star{align-self:center}.lk-up{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;flex:none;align-self:center;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:32px;height:32px;margin:-6px 0;border-radius:50%;font-size:17px;line-height:1;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}.lk-up:hover{color:var(--accent)}.lk-up:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent)}.lk-find{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s3);margin:var(--s3) 0 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lk-find input{flex:1 1 220px;min-width:0;max-width:420px;box-sizing:border-box;font:16px var(--font);padding:6px var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.lk-find input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}.lk-favn{margin:var(--s1) 0 0}
@media (max-width:879px){
.lk-home .lk-open .idb{display:inline}.lk-home .lk-run .t b{font-size:13px}.lk-run .lk-faces img{width:28px;height:28px}
.lk-bub{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.lk-f{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--s2) var(--s3)}.lk-f>span:nth-child(n+3){display:none}
.lk-cols{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.lk-cols>*{min-width:0}
.lk-q .idb,.lk-qr .idb{display:none}
.lk-acct{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:var(--s1)}.lk-acct.hd{display:none}.lk-bl{display:block}
.lk-bnr{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:var(--s1) var(--s3)}.lk-bnr>b{grid-column:1/-1}.lk-bnr .lk-bar2{grid-template-columns:1fr auto}
.lk-key{grid-template-columns:90px 1fr;gap:var(--s1) var(--s3)}.lk-key>span:last-child{grid-column:2}
.lk-stc{display:inline-flex;margin-top:var(--s2)}.lk-rt .lk-nt{display:none}
.lk-sims{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lk-team img{width:48px;height:48px}
.lk-side{display:none}}
/* T-4313 (friesevan #41 c6862221970): Merged, In flight and Queued each fold under its own header, a details whose summary
   is the header row; a chevron before the name turns down when open. 44 px tall at least, for a thumb. */
.lk-fold>summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;min-height:44px;align-items:center;border-radius:var(--r-s)}
.lk-fold>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.lk-fold>summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.lk-fold>summary>.lk-h::before{content:"";display:inline-block;box-sizing:border-box;width:9px;height:9px;margin:0 10px 3px 2px;border:solid var(--muted);border-width:0 2px 2px 0;transform:rotate(-45deg);transition:transform .15s}
.lk-fold[open]>summary>.lk-h::before{transform:rotate(45deg)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lk-fold>summary>.lk-h::before{transition:none}}
.lk-fin{margin:0 0 var(--s2);font-size:13px}.lk-fin>summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);padding:var(--s1) 0}.lk-fin>summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent)}
.lk-fin ul{list-style:none;margin:var(--s1) 0;padding:0}.lk-fin li{padding:2px 0}.lk-fin p{margin:0}
/* T-3284: In flight, Maren's T-3095 NEW rules (scroll-padding is site.css's, T-3185; the account tag is lk-tag). Evan
   (#41 c6708949111): the track is the phone's bars at every width, no step names on the steps; the key and each bar's
   hover card name them, and an open card adds the steps in words (lk-hw). */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){html{scroll-behavior:smooth}}
a.lk-ch{text-decoration:none}
a.lk-ch.lk-jump::after{content:"\2193";color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;margin-left:-1px}
a.lk-ch.lk-jump:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}a.lk-ch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
.lk-pan:target,.lk-pan h3:target,.lk-pan .lk-qr:target,.lk-pan .lk-blk:target{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:var(--r-s)}
.lk-hist{display:flex;flex-wrap:nowrap;gap:3px;align-items:center;margin:var(--s2) 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.lk-hist li{font-size:0;height:10px;padding:0;margin:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:3px;flex:1 1 0;min-width:6px;max-width:40px}.lk-hist li small{font-size:0}
.lk-hist li.d,.lk-hist li.lb,.lk-hk .d{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok)}.lk-hist li.f,.lk-hk .f{background:var(--hot);border-color:var(--hot)}
.lk-hist li.a,.lk-hk .a{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}.lk-hist li.x,.lk-hk .x{background:var(--amber-fg);border-color:var(--amber-fg)}
.lk-hist li.q,.lk-hk .q{background:var(--grey-bg);border:1px dashed var(--grey-fg)}.lk-hist li.n,.lk-hk .n{border-style:dotted;border-color:var(--grey-fg)}
.lk-hist li.e{font-size:11px;height:auto;max-width:none;flex:none;border:0;padding:0 4px 0 0;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer}
.lk-open .lk-hist{flex-wrap:wrap}.lk-open .lk-hist li.e{display:none}.lk-hist li.old{display:none}.lk-open .lk-hist li.old{display:block}
.lk-hw{display:none;margin:var(--s1) 0 0;font-size:12px}.lk-open .lk-hw{display:block}
.lk-hk{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px 12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 var(--s2)}
.lk-hk i{display:inline-block;width:14px;height:8px;border-radius:2px;margin-right:4px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
.lk-tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 6px;margin-left:2px;white-space:nowrap}
.lk-qr a,.lk-blk a,.lk-pan h3 small a{color:var(--blue-fg);font-weight:600}
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-tag{display:none}}
/* T-3318 (friesevan #41 c6709119877): what runs the task (Main plan, an account's name, Company API credits, Key A), at every
   width; a long account name ends in an ellipsis. */
.lk-home .lk-tag.lk-src{display:inline-block;max-width:16em;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;vertical-align:bottom;line-height:16px}
/* T-3427 (friesevan #41 c6717936054, c6718358111): each task's category (App, Site, Efficiency, Pitches, with its
   subcategory), as words in the lk-tag outline at every width; neutral, so colour is never the cue. */
.lk-home span.lk-cat{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:16px;color:var(--muted);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 6px;white-space:nowrap;vertical-align:baseline}
.lk-home .t span.lk-cat{margin-left:4px}.lk-q>.lk-cat{flex:none}.lk-home .lk-qr b .lk-cat{margin-top:2px}
/* T-3316 (friesevan #41 c6709231564; redone as T-3434): closed, a badge with the count of parents and children; open, the
   full tree. A row with a card is a link; a row with none is its name and one word. Depth is drawn as indent (at most five).
   T-4100 (redone as T-4310): one badge for each kind of link (the umbrella, the dependency, the prose cues), each one
   line, so a card with all three wraps between badges and never inside one. */
.lk-home .lk-lin{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:16px;color:var(--blue-fg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 7px;white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}
.lk-run .lk-lin{margin-left:var(--s2)}.lk-q .t .lk-lin{margin-top:2px}.lk-q .t .lk-lin+.lk-lin{margin-left:4px}
/* T-3950: an open card in the merge line or the Simulator's line links to its own line on This Session */
.lk-home .lk-sq{display:none;margin:var(--s1) 0 0;font-size:12px}.lk-home .lk-open>.lk-sq{display:block}
.lk-tree{display:none;margin-top:var(--s2);padding-top:var(--s1);border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-size:12px;cursor:auto}.lk-open>.lk-tree{display:block}
.lk-q.lk-open:has(.lk-tree){flex-wrap:wrap}.lk-q.lk-open:has(.lk-tree)>.t{flex:1 1 0}.lk-q>.lk-tree{flex:0 0 100%;box-sizing:border-box}
.lk-tree h4{margin:var(--s1) 0 0;font:600 11px var(--font);color:var(--muted)}
.lk-tree ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}.lk-tree li{margin:0;padding:3px 0;line-height:1.3}
.lk-tree li>a,.lk-tree li>span{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:6px;min-width:0}.lk-tree li>a{color:var(--blue-fg);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}.lk-tree li>a:hover .lk-tt{text-decoration:underline}
.lk-tree .lk-tt{flex:1;min-width:0}.lk-tree .lk-ts{flex:none;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;white-space:nowrap}.lk-tree li>span{color:var(--muted)}
.lk-tree .idb{flex:none}.lk-tree li.lk-tm{color:var(--muted)}
.lk-hit{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-tree li>a{min-height:36px;align-items:center}}
/* T-4007 (JeremyFries and friesevan, #41, 2026-11-10): the one list of every task, under Flow's chart: In flight, then
   Queued, with the cards and rows above as they were before T-3996. Its two parts keep their old headings, drawn
   small, as the dividers. One search, one sort and one category choice for both (16 px, so a phone does not zoom in
   on them). A card in the merge line says where its change stands beside its stage chip. Only the page's own tokens. */
.lk-all{margin-top:var(--s4);padding-top:var(--s3);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.lk-all>.lk-rh>.lk-h{margin-top:0}.lk-all .lk-find{margin:0 0 var(--s3)}
.lk-dv>.lk-h{font-size:var(--fs-2);margin:var(--s3) 0 var(--s2)}
.lk-find label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;overflow-wrap:normal}
.lk-find select{box-sizing:border-box;min-height:36px;max-width:100%;font:16px var(--font);padding:4px var(--s2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink)}
.lk-find select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
/* T-3430: category chips (lk-ch, as the stage chips) in the find box's own row; pressed = filled, underlined and bolder, so colour is not the only cue */
.lk-find .lk-chips{flex:1 0 100%;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.lk-find .lk-chips button.lk-ch{min-height:32px;padding:4px 12px}
.lk-find .lk-chips button.lk-ch:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}.lk-find .lk-chips button.lk-ch[aria-pressed="true"]{text-decoration:underline;font-weight:800}
.lk-find .lk-subs{padding-left:var(--s3);border-left:2px solid var(--line)}
.lk-find .lk-cfs{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.lk-mg{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-left:var(--s2)}
/* T-4094: a sort and its direction stay together on a line; the direction is a word, the pill the selects wear */
.lk-so{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:nowrap;max-width:100%}.lk-so[hidden],.lk-dir[hidden]{display:none}
.lk-dir{all:unset;box-sizing:border-box;min-height:36px;padding:4px var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--accent);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.lk-dir:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:1px}
.lk-nw{white-space:nowrap}.lk-rty{flex:none;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
#lk-q-rest{margin:var(--s1) 0 0}
/* This Session's stage columns and marks (session_page.PAGE_CSS, in this page's style after these rules) as Home lays
   them out: five columns, since a listed task is never Handed out or Merged; no name column at any width, so the
   row of columns and every card's track are exactly as wide as a card's inside and each mark sits under its stage.
   T-4287: the cards sit in a scroll box (its border and padding, and a scroll bar's gutter where the system draws one),
   so the row of columns is inset by the same and reserves the same gutter. */
.lk-all .ts-r,.lk-all .ts-trk{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}
.lk-all .ts-r>.ts-rh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}
.lk-all .ts-cols{padding:var(--s1) calc(var(--s3) + var(--s2) + 2px) 0;overflow:hidden;scrollbar-gutter:stable}.lk-all .ts-key{padding:var(--s1) 0 var(--s2)}.lk-keyd{margin:var(--s1) 0 var(--s2)}.lk-keyd>.ts-key{padding:var(--s1) 0 0}
/* T-4287's box at phone width: no side border or padding, so cards and the row of stage names keep the width they had
   before the box (at 390 px the inset left each name 49 px and "Simulator" broke mid-word; 52 px holds it). The top and
   bottom rules and the soft edges still say where the box ends. */
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-box{padding:var(--s2) 0 0;border-width:1px 0;border-radius:0}.lk-all .ts-cols{padding:var(--s1) calc(var(--s3) + 1px) 0}}
.lk-run .ts-trk{margin-top:var(--s2)}
/* at 390 px the list reaches a little past Flow's padding, so a card keeps nearly the width it had outside a box; and
   a queued row with a badge or two lets them wrap under its name, which then keeps most of the row */
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-tasks .lk-all{margin-left:calc(-1*var(--s2));margin-right:calc(-1*var(--s2))}
.lk-all .lk-q{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:2px}.lk-all .lk-q>.t{flex:1 1 55%}.lk-all .lk-q.lk-open:has(.lk-tree)>.t{flex:1 1 55%}}
/* T-3996 (the Investors' mandate of 2026-11-10): Home answers six questions. Phone first: one column, the Flow strip two
   cells a row with Waiting to merge across both; from 880px the strip is one row of five. Only the page's own tokens. */
.lk-hd{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:baseline;gap:2px var(--s2);margin:0 0 var(--s3);font-size:var(--fs-2);color:var(--muted)}
.lk-hd b{font-size:var(--fs-4);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);margin-right:var(--s1)}.lk-hd span{white-space:nowrap}.lk-hd small{flex:1 1 100%}
.lk-hd .lk-rep{font-size:12px}.lk-hd .lk-rep.late{color:var(--amber-fg)}.lk-hd .lk-reply:has(.lk-rep[hidden]){display:none}
.lk-sec{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s3) var(--s4);margin:0 0 var(--s3)}
.lk-mls2{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--s1) var(--s4)}.lk-mls2 li{font-size:var(--fs-0)}.lk-mls2 .lk-mn{color:var(--muted)}
.lk-mode .lk-lm select{font:inherit;min-height:36px}.lk-mode .lk-acc{margin-top:var(--s2)}
/* T-4246 (friesevan #41 c6850703999): Mode is a bubble in the first line, the old Lock In pill's size (12px, 24px tall);
   its ::after stretches the tap area to 44px without growing the pill. A tap opens the controls under the line. */
.lk-hd .lk-mb{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;align-self:center;margin:0;padding:3px 8px 3px 10px;
font:600 12px/16px var(--font);color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);cursor:pointer;
white-space:nowrap;max-width:100%;overflow:visible}.lk-hd .lk-mb>span{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.lk-mb::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-10px -2px}.lk-mb:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.lk-mb[aria-expanded="true"]{border-color:var(--accent)}.lk-hd .lk-mb b.lk-mbl{font:inherit;margin:0;color:var(--muted)}.lk-mb i{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);transition:transform .15s}
.lk-mb[aria-expanded="true"] i{transform:rotate(180deg)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.lk-mb i{transition:none}}
.lk-mpop{border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:var(--s3) var(--s4);margin:calc(-1 * var(--s2)) 0 var(--s3);background:var(--bg)}
.lk-mpop>:last-child,.lk-mpop .lk-acc>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.lk-sec>.lk-h,.lk-sec>.lk-rh>.lk-h{margin-top:0}.lk-sec>:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.lk-sec p{margin:0 0 var(--s2)}
/* T-4015 (friesevan #41 c6776728481): Now is one line, a slim bar under the header: a gate chip, the count with its gauge
   against the limit, the mode and its exit clock, the time. It wraps to two lines at 390 px, never more. */
.lk-now{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px var(--s3);margin:0 0 var(--s3);padding:6px var(--s3) 6px 6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);background:var(--page);font-size:var(--fs-1);line-height:1.3}
.lk-now>span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;white-space:nowrap}.lk-now small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-now b{font-size:var(--fs-2);font-weight:800}.lk-now .lk-nwhen{margin-left:auto}.lk-now .lk-nwhen.late{color:var(--warm)!important;font-weight:600}
.lk-gate{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:3px 10px 3px 8px;background:var(--grey-bg);color:var(--grey-fg)}
.lk-gate::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:currentColor}
.lk-gate.held{background:var(--amber-bg);color:var(--amber-fg)}.lk-gate.ok{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.lk-gg{position:relative;display:inline-block;width:56px;height:6px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--soft-2)}
.lk-gg i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;border-radius:3px;background:var(--accent)}.lk-gg.over i{background:var(--warm)}
.lk-gg u{position:absolute;top:-3px;width:2px;height:12px;margin-left:-1px;background:var(--ink);border-radius:1px}
.lk-now .lk-nq{color:var(--ink)}.lk-now .lk-nq b{font-size:inherit;font-weight:700}.lk-now .lk-ws{display:none}
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-now{border-radius:var(--r-l);padding:6px var(--s2);gap:4px var(--s2)}.lk-now .lk-wd{display:none}.lk-now .lk-ws{display:inline}
.lk-now .lk-gg{width:40px}.lk-now small{font-size:11px}.lk-now .lk-nwhen{margin-left:0}
.lk-p .lk-sx{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.lk-asof{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-fs{list-style:none;margin:0 0 var(--s3);padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:var(--s2)}
.lk-fs li>b i{font-style:normal;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-left:2px}
.lk-fs li{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s2) var(--s3)}
.lk-fs li>span{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}.lk-fs li>b{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2}
.lk-fs li>b.nr,.lk-nr{font-size:var(--fs-1);font-weight:600;font-style:italic;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-fs li>small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-tr{display:inline-block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:18px;border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 8px;margin-left:var(--s2);vertical-align:middle;white-space:nowrap;background:var(--grey-bg);color:var(--grey-fg)}
.lk-tr.up{background:var(--hot-bg);color:var(--hot)}.lk-tr.down{background:var(--ok-bg);color:var(--ok)}
.lk-chart{margin:var(--s3) 0 var(--s2)}.lk-chart figcaption{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 var(--s1)}
.lk-plot{position:relative;height:120px;margin:0 6px 0 0}
.lk-plot svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}
.lk-plot .gr{stroke:var(--line);stroke-width:1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.lk-plot .lm{stroke:var(--muted);stroke-width:1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.lk-plot .ln{fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.lk-plot .hit{fill:transparent}.lk-plot .hit:hover{fill:var(--accent-soft);fill-opacity:.5}
.lk-plot span{position:absolute;font-size:11px;line-height:1;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.lk-plot .lk-yl{left:0;transform:translateY(-50%);background:var(--page);padding-right:4px}
.lk-plot .lk-ll{left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-120%)}
.lk-plot .lk-pt{width:8px;height:8px;margin:-6px 0 0 -6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);border:2px solid var(--page)}
.lk-plot .lk-pv{transform:translate(-100%,-150%);margin-left:-8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);background:var(--page);padding:0 2px}
.lk-plot .lk-pv.dn{transform:translate(-100%,60%)}
.lk-xl{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin:var(--s1) 6px 0 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-ct{margin:var(--s1) 0 0;font-size:13px}.lk-ct summary{color:var(--accent);font-weight:600}.lk-ct table{font-size:13px;max-width:320px}
.lk-al{margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:2px 0}
.lk-al dt{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);margin-top:var(--s2)}.lk-al dt:first-child{margin-top:0}.lk-al dd{margin:0}
.lk-al dd b{font-weight:800}
.lk-days{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:var(--s2);margin:var(--s1) 0 0;padding:0;max-width:340px}
.lk-days li{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-days li b{font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.lk-days li i{display:block;width:100%;max-width:24px;min-height:1px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 40%,var(--page))}
.lk-days li.now i{background:var(--accent)}.lk-days li.now span{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink)}
.lk-days .lk-dh{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;width:100%;justify-content:center;height:40px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lk-stuck{border-color:var(--hot)}.lk-stuck ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.lk-stuck li{display:flex;gap:var(--s2);align-items:baseline;padding:var(--s1) 0}.lk-stuck li::before{content:"!";flex:none;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--hot-bg);color:var(--hot);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;line-height:18px;text-align:center}
.lk-stuck li small{display:block}
.lk-six{margin:var(--s4) 0 0}.lk-p .lk-six .lk-h3{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 var(--s2);padding:0;border:0}
.lk-six .lk-h3 small{font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);margin-left:8px}
/* T-4014: six tiles, each a bar for yesterday and one for today so far, scaled to the larger of the two */
.lk-sx{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:var(--s2)}
.lk-sx li{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-m);padding:var(--s2) var(--s3)}
.lk-sx li>b{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted)}.lk-sx li>small{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-sr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6.2em minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-sr i{display:block;height:8px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:var(--soft-2)}.lk-sr u{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent) 40%,var(--page))}
.lk-sr.now u{background:var(--accent)}.lk-sr em{font-style:normal;font-size:var(--fs-1);font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
.lk-sr.now>span{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}.lk-sr em.nr{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;font-style:italic;color:var(--muted)}
.lk-p h2 small{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;margin-left:8px}
.lk-chart figcaption .lk-tr{margin-left:var(--s2)}.lk-chart figcaption small{font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);margin-left:6px}
/* T-4014: Flow's bubble takes the row's width under the other four: its figures, then the one count's 24-hour line */
.lk-bw{grid-column:1/-1}.lk-bw .lk-f{align-items:flex-end}
.lk-home .lk-bw .lk-f>span{display:flex}.lk-spark{flex:1 1 160px;min-width:120px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px}
.lk-spark svg{display:block;width:100%;height:30px;overflow:visible}
.lk-spark polyline{fill:none;stroke:var(--accent);stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.lk-spark line{stroke:var(--muted);stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:3 3;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.lk-tasks>.lk-all{margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0}
.lk-sec.lk-mo{border:0;padding:0;margin-top:var(--s5)}.lk-mo .lk-dd{margin:var(--s2) 0}.lk-mo .lk-p{margin:var(--s3) 0 0}
/* More is no box of its own, and at 390 px the old requests and Sent back have no box either: a row keeps the full width */
@media (max-width:879px){.lk-home #requests.lk-p,.lk-home #sent-back.lk-p{border:0;padding:0}}
@media (min-width:880px){.lk-hd small{flex:0 1 auto;margin-left:auto}
.lk-fs{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.lk-sx{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.lk-al{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,15em) minmax(0,1fr);gap:var(--s2) var(--s4)}.lk-al dt{margin-top:0;padding-top:2px}}

.ts-cn{align-items:start;font-size:var(--fs-3);font-weight:800;color:var(--ink);padding-top:2px}.ts-cn small{display:block;font-size:10px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15;color:var(--muted)}
.ts-ty{color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:var(--s2)}
.ts-r>.ts-rh{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap}

.ts-key{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:2px 12px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:0;padding:0 var(--p) var(--s2)}

.ts-w>summary::-webkit-details-marker,.ts-t>summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}

.ts-wn::before{content:"\203A";flex:none;width:10px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:800}
.ts-w[open]>summary .ts-wn::before{transform:rotate(90deg)}

.ts-wn em{font-style:normal;margin-left:auto;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.ts-wr,.ts-trk{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));align-items:center}
.ts-wr{text-align:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ts-wr .z{color:var(--muted);font-weight:400}

.ts-wt{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.ts-live{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r-pill);padding:0 6px;margin-left:4px;color:var(--blue-fg);white-space:nowrap}
.ts-h{padding:var(--s2) var(--p) var(--s3);font-size:13px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.ts-hd2{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:var(--s2);align-items:center;margin:0 0 var(--s2);font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.ts-id{font:11px var(--mono);background:var(--grey-bg);color:var(--grey-fg);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px;line-height:14px;white-space:nowrap}

.ts-tl li.f::before{background:var(--hot);border-color:var(--hot)}.ts-tl li.m::before{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--ok)}
.ts-tl li.c::before{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent)}
.ts-tl time,.ts-tl .ts-ln{grid-row:1;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}.ts-tl .ts-ln{grid-column:2;text-align:right}

.ts-foot h2{font-size:var(--fs-1);color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 var(--s2)}.ts-foot ul{margin:0;padding-left:var(--s4);max-width:var(--measure)}.ts-foot li{margin:0 0 var(--s1)}

.ts-pg{--g:38%;--p:var(--s4)}
.ts-cols{font-size:12px}.ts-cn{font-size:var(--fs-4)}.ts-cn small{font-size:11px}
.ts-r{grid-template-columns:var(--g) repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr))}
.ts-r>.ts-rh{position:static;width:auto;height:auto;clip:auto;overflow:visible;white-space:normal;padding:2px var(--s2) 2px 0;text-align:left;align-self:center;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--muted)}
.ts-w>summary,.ts-t>summary{grid-template-columns:var(--g) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:0}
.ts-nm,.ts-nw{grid-column:1;padding-right:var(--s3)}.ts-trk{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 2;align-self:center}
.ts-tl li{grid-template-columns:11.5em minmax(0,1fr) auto}.ts-tl .ts-wh{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}.ts-tl .ts-ln{grid-column:3}
.ts-h{padding-left:calc(var(--p) + var(--s4))}
.ts-now>li{grid-template-columns:var(--g) minmax(0,1fr);column-gap:0}.ts-now .ts-nm{grid-row:1/span 2;padding-right:var(--s3)}

}

.mx>input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px;pointer-events:none}
.mx-hd{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--s3);flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:var(--s1)}
